analysis_notes.gap_analysis_summary: The source text of LM2 Torah #123 contains no bechina declarations. A careful reading of the full text identifies the following distinct concepts: טְבִילַת מִקְוֶה (mikveh immersion), נִקְבֵי הַזֵּעָה (sweat pores), בְּרִיאוּת הַגּוּף (bodily health), מַיִם (water / immersion water), גַּדְלוּת (pride / expansiveness of self), and עֲבוֹדָה וְסִגּוּפִים (ascetic practices). None of these are connected by the formula 'X הוּא בְּחִינַת Y'. The connections in the text are all causal or explanatory: mikveh causes the pores to open (עַל-יְדֵי טְבִילָה בְּמַיִם נִפְתָּחִין נִקְבֵי הַזֵּעָה); open pores cause good health; blocked pores cause weakness; pride causes the ascetic practices to be harmful. These are all eitza (cause-and-effect) relationships and do not generate bechina edges or packages. There are no missing bechina nodes to flag.
